patch_description: The previous edit that added two ZZZ three-qubit interactions to the secondary cluster regressed performance (score 0.59 vs 0.63 baseline), likely due to increased depth/parameter count without a corresponding gain in expressivity for this data. This edit reverts that change and instead follows the hub-and-spoke densification recommendation: replace the ZZZ block with two additional CRZ entanglers on the secondary cluster (wires (1,5) and (2,3)), sharing a single new parameter "crz_12". This keeps the two-qubit-gate-only structure (which scored better empirically), adds modest connectivity between the two chains (1-3-5 and 2-4-6/8), and only increases parameter count by 1 while adding 2 gates, in contrast to the previous edit's use of unrestricted-but-costly 3-qubit gates.
